verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms the web app lets developers/managers/stakeholders 'view, inspect, and comment' on work (sketch-docs-62) and iOS app allows adding comments (sketch-docs-58), but there is no direct evidence of @mentioning teammates or resolving comment threads specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation of @mention functionality, thread resolution/closing mechanics, and any hands-on or community corroboration that in-file review replaces email workflows.
